subject: Literature
title: Federico García Lorca and Duende
description: A short lesson to help you apply Federico García Lorca and Duende.

hook.text: García Lorca believed that the greatest art comes from duende: a dark, irrational force that arrives through suffering.

buildup.text: His poetry fused Andalusian folklore, flamenco rhythms, and surrealist imagery into a voice uniquely Spanish.

discovery.text: Romancero Gitano celebrated the Romani people of Spain and became the most popular poetry book in Spanish history.

twist.text: At thirty-eight, Lorca was murdered by fascist forces at the start of the Spanish Civil War. His body was never found.

climax.text: His death made him a martyr for artistic freedom and proved that poetry can threaten those who fear its power.

punchline.text: They killed the poet, but the poems survived everything.

quiz.question: What is duende in Lorca's artistic philosophy?
options: A type of Spanish musical instrument
A dark, irrational force that arrives through suffering and produces great art
A formal poetic structure with strict rules
